name: Play.ht
summary: Text-to-speech service whose domain no longer resolves.
description: Play.ht was a text-to-speech product. On 21 October 2026, www.play.ht had no DNS address. A third-party shutdown list dates the closure to 31 December 2025. This pass did not open a vendor notice.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: No live site, so the old price was not rechecked.

features: AI audio processing: Play.ht supports automated audio analysis and enhancements.
Transcription support: Provides tools for converting speech to text.
Noise reduction: Reduces unwanted sounds from audio input.
Voice synthesis: Can generate or clone voices using AI models.
User-friendly interface: Simple design for creators and professionals.

howToUse.title: Create Account & Log In
howToUse.description: Sign up on Play.ht and access the dashboard.

howToUse.title: Input Text
howToUse.description: Paste or type the text you want converted to speech.

howToUse.title: Select Voice & Language
howToUse.description: Choose from 800+ AI voices in different languages.

howToUse.title: Generate & Download Audio
howToUse.description: Listen to, edit, and download your generated audio.

statusNote: Web search: Meta acquired PlayHT (MarketScreener/S&P, Jul 12 2025); Inworld migration guide: all products closed Dec 31 2025; box: play.ht does not resolve
